items.question: What is an Init7 referral code?
items.answer: An Init7 referral code is a code that gives new customers a CHF 111 discount when signing up for an Init7 subscription. Copy the code and enter it during checkout to receive the discount.

items.question: How do I redeem the Init7 referral code?
items.answer: Copy the referral code from this website, go to Init7, choose your subscription, and enter the code during checkout. The discount will be applied automatically.

items.question: Is this an official Init7 website?
items.answer: No, this website is not officially affiliated with Init7 AG. It is an independent site that explains how to use the Init7 referral code.

items.question: What discount do I receive?
items.answer: You receive a CHF 111 discount on your Init7 subscription when you enter the referral code during checkout.

items.question: Does the referral code still work?
items.answer: The referral code is part of the Init7 referral programme. As long as the programme is active, the code can be used. This page is checked regularly.

items.question: Is the Init7 referral code a voucher or promo code?
items.answer: The Init7 referral code works like a voucher or promo code. You enter it during checkout to receive a CHF 111 discount on your subscription.

items.question: Which subscriptions does the Init7 discount apply to?
items.answer: The CHF 111 discount applies to eligible Init7 subscriptions. Check the Init7 referral programme page for current participation conditions and eligible plans.

items.question: Can I combine the Init7 promo code with other offers?
items.answer: Whether the referral code can be combined with other promotions depends on Init7's terms. Check the official Init7 referral programme page for current conditions.
